svg.title: $31.3 billion in estimated U.S. construction rework, 2018
svg.desc: PlanGrid and FMI estimated 31.3 billion U.S. dollars in construction rework linked to poor project data and communication in 2018. Historical industry context, not measured AI Inspector savings or the cost of inspection delays.

g.text: 2018 · PlanGrid / FMI · Historical industry estimate, not measured product savings
